# Rapfi WebAssembly

This directory contains the single-threaded, non-SIMD Rapfi 0.42.01 browser
build published by the Rapfi project as the fallback engine for
[Gomoku Calculator](https://gomocalc.com/).

Rapfi is Copyright (C) Rapfi developers and is licensed under GNU GPL v3 or
later. See `COPYING.txt` and `AUTHORS`.

The corresponding Rapfi source is available at:

- https://github.com/dhbloo/rapfi/tree/449d88373b0be811a80642687bb956dfbf4a9347
- https://github.com/dhbloo/rapfi/blob/449d88373b0be811a80642687bb956dfbf4a9347/Readme.md#build-for-webassembly
- https://github.com/dhbloo/rapfi-networks
